release_changes: Notebook source is redacted before export; original source-projection digest is retained for identity.
Default candidate inspection is unbounded; optional cap is explicit and reported.
Shared-drive folder traversal attempts allDrives and falls back to user corpus with a warning.
Per-file downloads are bounded at 50,000,000 bytes by default.
Pulled filenames are prefixed by Drive file ID to prevent same-name overwrites.
Receipt ledger snapshot is included in the outbox report set.
Colab notebook pins the federation module to an immutable Git commit.

historical_observations.limitation: Historical connector observations only. Drive createdTime is not original source authorship time. The previous search was not a complete export of all historical Drive data.

federation_model.strategy: shared-folder federation through one active Colab OAuth principal
federation_model.coverage_rule: Only files visible to the active Colab principal or explicitly shared roots can be inventoried.
federation_model.default_scan_scope: all visible user corpus + allDrives corpus + configured shared roots + indexed fullText candidates

private_data_handling.source_ids_and_root_ids: Colab Secrets or private Drive configuration only
private_data_handling.previous_git_history: Earlier commits retain the v1 Drive IDs; current-tree redaction does not rewrite history.
private_data_handling.owner_identity: one-way SHA-256 aliases; raw owner emails are not exported

security.in_place_replace: explicit only; expected SHA-256 + verified backup; optimistic and not atomic
security.notebook_source_redaction: Applied to notebook source included in exported records; raw byte SHA-256 and raw source-projection SHA-256 retained as identity values only.

evidence.notebook_json_validation: PASS — nbformat 4; 15 cells; line-array source; module reference pinned to immutable commit.
evidence.live_drive_scan: NOT_RUN — Google Drive connector disabled in current ChatGPT session; Colab runtime execution required.
evidence.cross_account_runtime_access: PENDING_COLAB_RUN — active Colab principal must be granted access to each source root.
evidence.live_gemini_smoke_test: PENDING_COLAB_RUN — uses GEMINI_API_KEY from Colab Secrets; key supplied in chat should be rotated.
evidence.full_jan_jun_2025_historical_completenes: NOT_ESTABLISHED — Drive createdTime is metadata and current search is not a full export of every account.
